fieldValues.title: Publish CLI payload golden schemas as a release asset
fieldValues.summary: crates/srs-cli/schemas/payload/ had no release-asset source, so the srs-vscode payload-schema mirror (srs-vscode#119 / PR #120) depended on a co-located srs-rust checkout at the right commit -- the stale-local-sibling trap srs-rust#874/#911 hardened the schemas/2.0/ mirror against. release.yml now packages the payload schemas as srs-cli-payload-schemas.tar.gz (+ .sha256), attached alongside the existing srs-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz and srs-bindings-web.tar.gz assets.
fieldValues.body:
Dispatched from the srs-rust gate:pool queue via the pool top-up on srs#580 (comment 5639954352, 2026-09-11 20:00Z): clear / ♓ Portability / non-normative door / auto-merge. Claimed 2026-09-11T~21:1xZ (issue comment 5640700289), swapping gate:dispatched -> gate:working.

Fix in srs-rust PR #1052: a new `package_payload_schemas` step in the `release` job of `.github/workflows/release.yml`, modelled directly on the existing `package_wasm` step in the same job -- `tar -czf` the whole `crates/srs-cli/schemas/payload/` directory, `sha256sum` it, and add both to the `gh release create` asset list and the release-notes body. Verified locally: `cargo build --workspace` green, `cargo test --test payload_contracts` 112/112 passed, a local `tar` dry-run over the schema directory produced the expected 161 files + one directory entry, and the edited workflow re-parses cleanly with `yaml.safe_load`. No new check or guard was added (this unit is a CI asset-publish step, not a validator), so the Prove stage does not apply -- there is nothing to make fail red.

PR #1052 opened with `gate:auto-merge`, auto-merge armed (SQUASH), and mode/cell/door stated in the PR body per the Land stage.
